title: fix(app-shell): an approver whose own decision ends their read sees "Decision recorded", not "Record not found"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb1ZM1TbDQjwJKexqenj9KYp)_
Fixes #26589

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 审批人在记录页上点「通过」或「拒绝」之后,如果这次决定让他对该记录的只读权限随审批环节结束而收回,页面不再显示「未找到记录」,而是显示「你的审批决定已记录」和「你的审批环节已结束,对此记录的访问权限也随之结束。」,并给出「打开审批中心」链接。
- **为什么改:** #26180 让审批人只在环节等待期间可读记录,环节结束即收回;记录页在决定之后会重读记录,得到 404,于是在「已通过」提示下面告诉审批人刚批的合同不存在。最常见的就是没有岗位的直属上级。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改前端显示,不延长任何读权限。新状态只在「本人刚在这条记录上做了决定、紧接着重读得到 404」时出现;其它 404(本来就不存在、没做决定、决定后换到另一条记录)仍是「未找到记录」。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 里 `decidedRecordRef` 的注释与赋值(`handleApprovalActionDone`)、记录加载 effect 里 404 分支的判断,以及新的 `accessEnded` 空状态。
- **两分钟验证:** 在仓根运行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.accessEndedAfterDecision-26589.test.tsx`,应见 5 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

The record page re-reads the record after every decision taken from its approval bar (`handleApprovalActionDone` in `RecordDetailView.tsx`). For a pending approver with no standing access, the server has revoked their read by then (the step ended), so the re-read answers 404 and the page drew its "Record not found" state under the "Approved" toast.

- `handleApprovalActionDone` now marks the record this viewer just decided (`decidedRecordRef`, object name plus record id) before the re-read goes out.
- The record load's 404 branch (the adapter resolves `null`) draws a new `accessEnded` status when the marker names the record being read, and `missing` otherwise. A read that answers the record clears the marker.
- `accessEnded` renders an empty state, `data-testid="record-access-ended"`: title "Decision recorded", description "Your approval step is complete, so your access to this record has ended.", and an outline button linking to `/apps/APP/system/approvals` (the approvals inbox, in the app segment the page is open in) with the existing "Open Approvals Inbox" label. The link is left out when the page has no app segment.
- i18n: `empty.recordAccessEnded` and `empty.recordAccessEndedDescription` in all ten locales; the link reuses `notifications.openApprovalsInbox`.
- The read itself is unchanged: nothing is kept past the step (the triage ruling).

## Why

Triage ruling 6438787968: the page shows "decision recorded, your access to this record has ended" with a link back to the inbox, not 「未找到记录」, and the read is not kept longer. A genuine not-found must not be masked, so the new state is drawn only for a 404 that follows this viewer's own decision on this record.

## Tests

New `RecordDetailView.accessEndedAfterDecision-26589.test.tsx` (5 tests), on the real record page and the real declared-action bar (the mock preamble of `RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx`):

- approve, then the re-read answers 404: the ended-access state with the inbox link (`href` `/apps/qms/system/approvals`), and no "Record not found";
- the same for reject;
- a decider whose read does not end keeps the record on screen, with neither empty state;
- a plain 404 with no decision still draws "Record not found";
- after a decision ends the read on one record, moving the same mounted page to another record that 404s draws "Record not found".

## Acceptance notes

- The card's mechanism assumption did not hold: the decision is not taken in `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx`. Since the declared-actions move, approve and reject on a business record run through the page's own `DeclaredActionsBar`, whose `onDone` is `handleApprovalActionDone` in `RecordDetailView.tsx`. That is where the page learns this viewer just decided, so `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx` is untouched.
- `onDone` carries no action name, so the marker is set for every refresh-requesting action in that bar: approve, reject, reassign, send back, request info and recall. Only an action that ends the viewer's read can turn the re-read into a 404, so request info (the step stays pending) and recall (the submitter keeps their own access) never reach the new state in practice. Reassign and send back do end the approver's step, and the "Decision recorded" copy reads well enough for them.
- The marker lives in the mounted page. A full reload of the URL after the decision draws "Record not found", as any later visit does: the ruling scopes the new state to "right after" the decision.
- The claim names one new pack key; the empty state follows the page's other empty states (title plus description), so it adds two keys. The declaration lines are copied from the claim.
